rusted lockers.description: A set of metal lockers, heavily rusted and bent. They've been thoroughly looted.

rusted microwave.description: An ancient microwave covered in rust. It's beyond repair.

rusted bed.description: A single bed frame with rusted metal and a torn mattress. It's better than sleeping on the ground, but just barely.

rusted double bed.description: A double bed with a sagging, rusted frame. It's better than sleeping on the ground, but just barely.

ancient ammo box.description: A container of ancient ammunition. It's empty and any remaining rounds are corroded to uselessness.

ancient antenna.description: A rusted antenna used to transmit long-forgotten communications.

ancient military generator.description: A small rusted generator. The fuel tank is empty and the engine is beyond repair.

broken autocannon turret.description: An autocannon turret with a shattered barrel. The targeting system is missing and all the components are rusted and bent to uselessness.

broken uranium slug turret.description: A heavy turret designed to fire uranium slugs. The mechanism is smashed and the ammo is depleted.

busted mortar.description: A shattered mortar emplacement. It's smashed and will never work again.

rusted open container.description: A rusted shipping container. Its contents are worthless.

ancient crate pallet.description: A pallet for stacking and transporting crates. The contents have been scavenged long ago.

old wooden crate.description: A weathered wooden crate. It's empty, and the wood is brittle.

ruined crane base.description: The base of a large industrial crane.

ruined crane arm.description: A rusted crane arm, twisted and broken.

ruined crane column.description: A vertical support column from a ruined crane. It's rusted and no longer stable.

ruined forklift.description: A broken forklift, rusted and missing parts. It's far too damaged to be repaired.

rusted industrial truck.description: An industrial truck, heavily rusted and abandoned. The engine is beyond repair.

rusted metal crate.description: A metal crate, now rusted shut. It's empty and worthless.

old cardboard box.description: An soggy cardboard box filled with old detritus.

ancient industrial shelf.description: An industrial shelf covered in rust. It offers nothing of value.

ancient shelf.description: An ancient shelf. It holds nothing of interest.

ancient small shelf.description: An ancient shelf. There's nothing useful left on it.

ancient destroyed console.description: A ruined console. It is now completely inoperable. Its usable parts were smashed or looted long ago.

medicine pallet.description: A pallet containing old medical supplies. Some items might still be usable.

survival meal pallet.description: A pallet containing survival meals. The contents are damaged but some meals might still be salvageable.

component box.description: A box filled with valuable components. Some are intact and useable.

advanced component box.description: A box of advanced components, well-preserved and potentially valuable.

steel scrap box.description: A box filled with steel scrap. It's heavy but might contain some recoverable metal.

malfunctioning transport pod.description: A cargo pod with a faulty release mechanism. It's still sealed, holding unknown contents.

chemfuel canister.description: A sealed canister of chemfuel. It might still contain usable fuel.

rusted safe.description: A locked safe. It's heavily rusted, making it easy to open. It may hold valuable items inside.

sealed container.description: A large sealed container. It may contain valuable supplies.

sealed crate.description: A small crate that's still sealed. There may be valuables inside.

steel scrap pallet.description: A pallet stacked with steel scrap. It could still hold some recoverable metal.

statue.description: A sculpture depicting a specific person. Artists will often make statues depicting friends or loved ones.

outfit stand.description: A small display that showcases a single outfit. Saves space and can be used to quickly change clothing.

kid outfit stand.description: A small display that showcases a single outfit for a child. Saves space and can be used to quickly change clothing.

relay stabilizer.description: A shield projecter that protects a nearby mechanoid relay. All stabilizers must be hacked or destroyed to deactivate the shield.\n\nDestroying a stabilizer will prompt a defensive response. Hacking is a slower but safer option.

crashed mechanoid relay.description: A node that coordinates signals across a planet-wide mechanoid communication network. The command signals originate at the mechhive - the center of mechanoid intelligence.

fortified wall.description: A heavily-reinforced wall made of an ultratech polymer.

ancient blast door.description: A heavily-reinforced door made of an ultratech polymer. Hack the door to open it.

ancient grav reactor.description: An ancient generator powered by a gravcore. Once capable of producing massive amounts of power, it has now fallen into disrepair. The reactor containment shield is leaking, causing toxic fallout to blanket the whole region.\n\nHack or destroy the reactor to obtain a gravcore. Be warned, it may explode if damaged.

ancient grav engine.description: An ultratech engine used to bring large structures and ships into orbit. While it has been nonfunctional for many years, it contains a functional gravcore.

ancient mining charge.description: An explosive device used to quickly blast through rock. It is made from refined chemfuel. The explosive is old, but still ready to detonate.

ancient explosives crate.description: A container of ancient mining charges. It will explode if damaged.

ancient security terminal.description: An ancient terminal. Hack it to disable nearby security systems.

egg sac.description: A slimy sac containing an insect larva. The larval gestation process generates a faint bioluminescent glow.

locust cocoon.description:
A stasis cocoon containing a locust.

When conditions are inhospitable, insects sometimes form stasis cocoons and burrow underground. These cocoons keep insects safe from fire, extreme temperatures, and other threats for years.

Pollutants can stimulate cocoons and cause them to resurface, and strong pollutants can attract cocoons from great distances.

Cocoons do nothing if they are not disturbed. If a cocoon is disturbed or destroyed, the insect within will awaken and attack, triggering other nearby cocoons in the process.

ancient transport pod.description: An ancient cargo pod capable of carrying people, animals, and items. It's still in working condition.

ancient stockpile entrance.description: The entrance to a long-abandoned subterranean facility. Hack it to open the hatch.

ancient stockpile exit.description: A ladder which links to the surface hatch above.

mechanoid drop pod.description: A launchable cargo pod intended to carry mechanoids. It is also usable for people, animals, and items.

ancient terraformer.description: An ancient terraforming device powered by a gravcore. It has begun to malfunction, causing temperatures to plummet.\n\nDestroy the terraformer to obtain a gravcore.

cerebrex core.description:
The thinking mind of the mechanoid swarm. The cerebrex core commands mechanoids across the entire planet.

At its heart is an AI persona core that knows, thinks, and believes that it must kill every human on this planet. In one sense, this impulse is a command programmed by a human military leader aeons ago. In another sense, it is cold seething hatred. Either way, if you liberate the AI persona you can reset its desire and use it for other purposes.

The structure is protected by nearby stabilizers. Destroy all cerebrex stabilizers to access it.

destroyed cerebrex core.description: The smashed neural nexus of the mechanoid swarm that once commanded mechanoids around the planet.

cerebrex stabilizer.description: A remote shield generator that makes the nearby cerebrex core nearly invincible. Destroying all stabilizers will allow direct access to the cerebrex core.\n\nBe careful, destroying a stabilizer will prompt a defensive response.

mech pylon.description: A node in a distributed mechanoid computation network.

surveying scanner.description: A wideband sensor unit that can detect and map various features in a local area.

ancient uplink.description: This area contains an uplink used for communication with a low orbit satellite. Hacking the uplink will reveal a hidden location in orbit.

gauss cannon.description: A massive anti-ship cannon that uses electromagnets to launch large metallic darts at extreme velocities. The cannon is intended to destroy incoming ships or shuttles, so it can't aim at ground targets.\n\nShips using ultratech signal jammers are capable of evading these weapons.

anticraft beam.description: A massive anti-ship beam weapon. This weapon is intended to destroy flying craft, so it can't aim low enough to hit ground targets.\n\nShips using ultratech signal jammers are capable of evading these weapons.

mechhive birther.description: An automated mechanoid factory. It periodically births fresh mechanoids.

cave entrance.description: The entrance to a cave network. It is possible to climb down into the caves below.

sulfur spout.description: A naturally-occurring break in the ground from which volcanic gases escape. These vents bring nutrients to the surface from deep underground. Collectively, the fumes they spew are enough to block out the sun.

burrow wall.description: A compact mix of dirt, rock, and insect secretion.

ancient smoke vent.description: This area has a number of massive exhaust vents. An ancient mechanism buried deep beneath the earth will occasionally vent large amounts of smoke, blocking out the sun for days at a time.

ancient toxic vent.description: Massive toxic vents will regularly spew toxic fallout into the air. The vents connect to an ancient substructure buried deep beneath the earth.

ancient heat vent.description: Ancient ducts will regularly vent heat from an underground megastructure, dramatically raising the temperature of the surrounding area.

mechanoid light.description: A light used in mechanoid facilities. The green hue is optimal for mechanoid optical arrays.

life support unit.description: A unit connected to the orbital platform's larger life support network. It keeps rooms heated and pressurized.

obsidian.description: A dark, glossy volcanic rock. Brittle but sharp, it makes for intimidating decor or vicious blades.

orbital scanner.description: A sensor unit that passively scans for irregular objects orbiting the planet. It will periodically detect locations in orbit that can be visited with transport pods, shuttles, or gravships.\n\nThe scanner won't function under a roof. Building multiple orbital scanners does not increase the chance to find new locations.

oxygen pump.description: A small wall-mounted unit that releases oxygen into the surrounding room, allowing enclosed areas to repressurize in space. Essential for long stays in orbit.

vac barrier.description: An ultrasonic barrier that prevents depressurization in space. The field compresses air molecules near the threshold, preventing gases from escaping while allowing people to freely travel through it. A vac barrier will do nothing to prevent intruders.\n\nMust be powered to prevent depressurization.

hunter trap.description: A dormant hunter drone that activates when it detects a threat. The hunter drone closes with the target and detonates. Since it is hidden in the surrounding terrain, it cannot be placed adjacent to other traps.

wasp trap.description: Several dormant wasp drones. They activate when they detect threats, injecting their target with a paralytic biotoxin.

ancient defender turret.description: An armored security turret containing a long-lasting battery.

ancient defender turret gun.description: A simple automatic gun made to be mounted on a turret.

mastodon tusk.description: A mastodon's tusk. Traders pay handsomely for samples like this. While somewhat unwieldy as a melee weapon, it still hits quite hard.

alpha thrumbo horn.description: An alpha thrumbo's horn. It's razor-sharp and priceless in most markets. This is a true trophy, as well as a deadly melee weapon.\n\nThe alpha horn is much lighter than a normal thrumbo horn, making it much faster to wield.

monitor lizard egg (unfert.).description: An unfertilized monitor lizard egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.

flamingo egg (unfert.).description: An unfertilized flamingo egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
